mapper.sql: id, uuid, username, password_hash, name, status, fail_count, locked_until, last_login_at, password_changed_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, organization_id, email_encrypted, email_iv, email_tag, email_hmac, email_key_version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM users WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT FROM users WHERE email_hmac = #{emailHmac} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET status = 'LOCKED', locked_until = #{until}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT FROM users WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id, uuid, username, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS email, name, status, last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM users
deleted_at IS NULL
AND (username ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR name ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%')
AND status = #{status}
ORDER BY
updated_at DESC updated_at ASC username ASC username DESC last_login_at DESC NULLS LAST last_login_at ASC NULLS LAST created_at ASC created_at DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users
deleted_at IS NULL
AND (username ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR name ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%')
AND status = #{status}

SELECT u.id, u.uuid, u.username, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS email, u.name, u.status, u.last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, u.created_at AS createdAt FROM users u
JOIN organization o ON o.id = u.organization_id
u.deleted_at IS NULL
AND (u.username ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR u.name ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%')
AND u.status = #{status}
AND o.path LIKE #{orgPathPrefix} || '%' AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
ORDER BY
u.updated_at DESC u.updated_at ASC u.username ASC u.username DESC u.last_login_at DESC NULLS LAST u.last_login_at ASC NULLS LAST u.created_at ASC u.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users u
JOIN organization o ON o.id = u.organization_id
u.deleted_at IS NULL
AND (u.username ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR u.name ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%')
AND u.status = #{status}
AND o.path LIKE #{orgPathPrefix} || '%' AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( username, password_hash, name, status, email_encrypted, email_iv, email_tag, email_hmac, email_key_version, password_changed_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{name}, COALESCE(#{status,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, 'ACTIVE'), #{emailEncrypted}, #{emailIv}, #{emailTag}, #{emailHmac}, COALESCE(#{emailKeyVersion}, 1), NOW(), NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET name = COALESCE(#{name}, name), status = COALESCE(#{status,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, status), email_encrypted = COALESCE(#{emailEncrypted}, email_encrypted), email_iv = COALESCE(#{emailIv}, email_iv), email_tag = COALESCE(#{emailTag}, email_tag), email_hmac = COALESCE(#{emailHmac}, email_hmac), email_key_version = COALESCE(#{emailKeyVersion},email_key_version), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_roles (user_id, role_code, granted_at, granted_by) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleCode}, #{now}, #{grantedBy}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, role_code) DO NOTHING
